paper.title_en: Segre Classification as a Framework for Generating Exact Solutions in Static Cylindrical Spacetimes with Levi-Civita Matching
paper.abstract_en: The main objective of this article is to analyze cylindrically symmetric static spacetime based on the Segre classification, where each Segre type corresponds to a set of canonical forms of Ricci spinors represented by Newman-Penrose scalars. The surviving Segre types of trace-free Ricci tensor in the cylindrical geometry are $[1,(111)]$, $[1,1(11)]$, $[(1,1)11]$, $[1,111]$, $[(1,11)1]$, $[(1,1)(11)]$ and $[(1,111)]$. Different combinations of eigenvalues and eigenvectors formed via Segre classification aid in understanding the distribution of matter and energy within that particular kind. Solutions are presented for the isotropic type $[1,(111)]$, for the anisotropic type $[1,1(11)]$, where a new metric function is introduced, and for type $[1,111]$, where all three pressures differ and the Krori-Barua functions are used. They satisfy the physical and stability criteria, namely the Zeldovich condition, causality condition, energy conditions and adiabatic index. The types $[(1,1)11]$ and $[(1,11)1]$ have $ρ=-P_r$ and give dark energy like configurations in which the strong energy condition is violated in the core, the latter having the tachyonic fluid form of the energy momentum tensor. For type $[(1,1)(11)]$, a charged solution in the presence of a non-null electromagnetic field is obtained and joined to an electrovac exterior. Matching with the Levi-Civita exterior shows that the vanishing of the radial pressure at the boundary is equivalent to the Darmois conditions. The C-energy and the curvature invariants are evaluated for each solution, and the results are compared with earlier works.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在静态柱对称时空下用Segre分类组织Ricci旋量的规范形式，为多种物质类型构造精确解，并系统检验物理与稳定性条件以及Levi-Civita外部匹配；方法体系较完整、主题契合引力理论基础，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 以Segre分类作为在静态柱对称时空中生成精确解并匹配Levi-Civita外部的框架
decision.abstract_zh: 本文的主要目标是基于Segre分类分析柱对称静态时空，其中每个Segre类型对应一组由Newman-Penrose标量表示的Ricci旋量的规范形式。柱几何中无迹Ricci张量存活的Segre类型为 $[1,(111)]$、$[1,1(11)]$、$[(1,1)11]$、$[1,111]$、$[(1,11)1]$、$[(1,1)(11)]$ 和 $[(1,111)]$。通过Segre分类形成的本征值和本征向量的不同组合有助于理解该类中物质与能量的分布。给出了各向同性类型 $[1,(111)]$ 的解，各向异性类型 $[1,1(11)]$ 的解（其中引入了一个新的度规函数），以及类型 $[1,111]$ 的解（其中三个压强均不相同并使用了Krori-Barua函数）。这些解满足物理与稳定性判据，即Zeldovich条件、因果性条件、能量条件和绝热指数。类型 $[(1,1)11]$ 和 $[(1,11)1]$ 具有 $ρ=-P_r$，给出在核心处违反强能量条件的类暗能量构型，后者具有能量动量张量的快子流体形式。对于类型 $[(1,1)(11)]$，在存在非零电磁场的情况下得到了一个带电解，并将其连接到电真空外部。与Levi-Civita外部的匹配表明，边界处径向压强的消失等价于Darmois条件。对每个解计算了C-能量和曲率不变量，并将结果与先前工作进行了比较。
